$comment: A team member's stored fields: the person shape (contract/collections/_person.json), flat. A team member is a record with no login, separate from login accounts, and anyone on the team can be credited as a post's author without an account (the founder's rulings of 18/11/2026). Salt for WordPress keeps its team_member post type. Team has no topics (SC-027). Every published team member has a public page of their own (the founder's ruling of 19/11/2026): the author page (contract/markup/archive.json), which draws the member's role, bio, photo, email, phone and social links, and the member's posts when there are any; its address is each platform's own routing (SC-003). No page lists the whole team: team has no index page, so a section of team draws no view-all link. The editor's order is each platform's own.

profiles.note: Each row in order: name names the link, url is its address, and the network is derived from the address (contract/socials.json).
